sections.title: Light World
sections.note: Escape with Zelda, the three Pendants of Virtue, the Master Sword and Agahnim.

items.name: Follow your uncle to Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Open the chest in Link's House for the Lamp, then go north to Hyrule Castle in the rain. Lift the bush on the east side of the castle grounds and drop into the secret passage, where your wounded uncle hands you his sword and shield.

items.name: Rescue Princess Zelda
items.howTo: Fight down into the castle's dungeon, defeat the Ball and Chain Trooper for the Big Key and open Zelda's cell.
items.notes: The castle's Map and the Boomerang are found on the way down.

items.name: Escort Zelda to the Sanctuary
items.howTo: Push the shelf in the throne room's back corner aside (Zelda shows you), follow the Sewer Passageway north and pull the switch to reach the Sanctuary north of the castle. The Loyal Sage there tells you to find the elder Sahasrahla.

items.name: Meet Sahasrahla
items.howTo: Sahasrahla's wife in Kakariko Village says he has gone east. Find him in his hideout near the Eastern Palace; he tells you of the three Pendants of Virtue and marks them on your map.

items.name: Eastern Palace (Armos Knights)
items.howTo: In the canyon in the far east of Hyrule. Take the Bow from the Big Chest and defeat the six Armos Knights.
items.notes: Treasure: Bow. Sahasrahla gives the Pegasus Shoes once you have the Pendant of Courage.

items.name: Desert Palace (Lanmolas)
items.howTo: Dash into the bookshelf of Kakariko's House of Books with the Pegasus Shoes for the Book of Mudora, then read the tablet at the entrance of the Desert of Mystery to open the palace. The Power Glove is in the Big Chest; the boss's wing is reached through the palace's back door.

items.name: Tower of Hera (Moldorm)
items.howTo: Lift the rocks on the way up Death Mountain with the Power Glove, lead the Lost Old Man home in the dark cave for the Magic Mirror, then step into the Dark World at the top and use the Mirror to reach the tower beyond Spectacle Rock.

items.name: Draw the Master Sword
items.howTo: With all three Pendants, draw the Master Sword from its pedestal deep in the Lost Woods.
items.notes: Zelda calls for help as soon as you draw it; the castle soldiers have taken her to the tower.

items.name: Hyrule Castle Tower (Agahnim)
items.howTo: Cut through the barrier at the top of Hyrule Castle with the Master Sword, climb the tower and defeat Agahnim by hitting his magic back at him with your sword (or the Bug-Catching Net).
items.notes: Agahnim gives no Heart Container. Afterwards the Pyramid of Power is your Dark World starting point.

sections.title: Dark World
sections.note: The seven Crystals, Ganon's Tower and Ganon. Levels 1-7 can be done in other orders where the items allow.

items.name: Palace of Darkness (Helmasaur King)
items.howTo: In the east, where the Eastern Palace stands in the Light World. Pay the monkey Kiki 10 Rupees to follow you through the hedge maze and 100 more to open the entrance. You need the Moon Pearl to keep your shape.

items.name: Swamp Palace (Arrghus)
items.howTo: South of the Bomb Shop. The first room is dry: use the Magic Mirror to reach the Great Swamp in the Light World, pull the lever in the Swamp Ruins to drain the pond, and the water floods into the palace. Swimming on needs Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Skull Woods (Mothula)
items.howTo: In the Skeleton Forest north of the Village of Outcasts. Enter through the skulls and pits until you find the Fire Rod, then use it to burn open the way into the boss's wing at the big skull in the north-west, where the Master Sword rests in the Light World.

items.name: Thieves' Town (Blind the Thief)
items.howTo: Under the gargoyle in the middle of the Village of Outcasts. Pull the prongs of its trident to open it. Take the girl from the cells to the sunlit room upstairs and bomb the cracked floor.

items.name: Ice Palace (Kholdstare)
items.howTo: Swim to the island in the middle of Lake Hylia in the Light World, lift the dark rock beside the Pond of Happiness with the Titan's Mitt and take the warp to the Ice Palace. Kholdstare's shell melts only to the Fire Rod or Bombos.
items.notes: Treasure: Blue Mail. Needs Zora's Flippers and the Titan's Mitt.

items.name: Misery Mire (Vitreous)
items.howTo: Fly to the Desert of Mystery with the Flute, lift the dark rock with the Titan's Mitt and take the warp to the Swamp of Evil. Use the Ether Medallion at the entrance to stop the storm.
items.notes: Treasure: Cane of Somaria. Can be done before Skull Woods or the Ice Palace.

items.name: Turtle Rock (Trinexx)
items.howTo: On the eastern peak of Death Mountain: pound the pegs with the Magic Hammer, lift the dark rock with the Titan's Mitt and take the warp on the peak to the turtle's back, then use the Quake Medallion to open it. The Cane of Somaria makes the platforms inside; Trinexx needs the Fire Rod and the Ice Rod.

items.name: Ganon's Tower (Agahnim)
items.howTo: With all seven Crystals, the maidens break the seal on Ganon's Tower on Dark World Death Mountain. Climb past the Armos Knights, Lanmolas and Moldorm again and defeat Agahnim a second time.
items.reward: Ganon flees to the Pyramid of Power
items.notes: Treasure: Red Mail. No Heart Container.

items.name: Pyramid of Power (Ganon)
items.howTo: Drop into the hole at the top of the Pyramid. Light the two torches with the Lamp or the Fire Rod when Ganon turns invisible, stun him with your sword and finish him with Silver Arrows.
items.notes: The Silver Arrows come from the Fat Fairy in the Pyramid (Items & Equipment). On the SNES only the Golden Sword hurts Ganon without a Spin Attack; on the GBA the Tempered Sword does too. GBA only: after beating Ganon and the Four Swords game, the Palace of the Four Sword opens in the Pyramid.
